items.t: Why MP Materials (MP) Is Back In The Spotlight
items.sum: MP Materials (MP) drew fresh attention after executives bought millions of dollars of company shares following a return to quarterly profitability and an easing backdrop in U.S. China trade relations. For context, MP Materials’ share price has fallen around 40% over the past three months and is down roughly 36% year to date. items.t: USA Rare Earth Drops 6% as China Extends Mineral Export Pause and New U.S. Tariffs Loom; Critical Metals Declines 5%, MP Materials Falls 3%
items.sum: Beijing eases its grip on critical minerals while Washington readies a tariff probe, and rare earth investors cannot tell which move matters more. Three very different companies face the same squeeze, and only one has real cash to ride it out.

items.t: USAR, CRML, UAMY, MP Stocks Drop Premarket: China Extends Mineral Export Pause Amid Looming US Tariff Hikes
items.sum: Chinese export curbs easing and potential U.S. tariffs keep critical mineral stocks volatile.

items.t: MP Materials Exec Makes First Stock Purchase Amid Insider Buying Spree
items.sum: MP Materials executives snap up millions in company shares following a recent return to quarterly profitability and easing U.S.-China trade tensions.

items.t: MP vs. USAR: Which Rare-Earth Stock Has an Edge Right Now?
items.sum: MP and USAR are expanding their rare-earth supply chains, but contrasting operating strengths, financial performance and growth prospects set them apart.

items.t: USA Rare Earth Jumps 13% as Critical Minerals Rebound With the Market; United States Antimony Rallies 9%, MP Materials Gains 6%
items.sum: A market-wide relief rally has yanked beaten-down rare earth stocks off the floor, but every name in the group still trades below where it stood a week ago. Can the bounce survive a holiday week without a fresh policy catalyst?
